beats.name: Medicine Case
beats.objective: Collect the medicine at the edge of the <Place>
beats.journal: I've got the medicine. I need to carry it through the contaminated site to the medic.
say: That's the case. Keep your helmet on until you're with me.

beats.objective: Bring the medicine to the medic at the <Place>
greeting: You came through that? Then you've got my medicine. Put it down there. Don't touch anything else.

exchanges.prompt: Your medicine. Where do you need it?
reply: Right there. That's three days of doses, and three days is all I need. Thank you.

exchanges.prompt: What is it? I might know it.
reply: Something off the local plants, we think. If you know better, write it down for me before you go.
